title: Ricardo Delgado
description: "Originally, editor Gary Gerani asked me to design Darth Vader's living room or something equally curious," recalls Ricardo Delgado. "I wound up depicting the wampa, that ferocious Hoth ice monster that is glimpsed very briefly in EMPIRE." Delgado wrote and illustrated the recent dinosaur epic AGE OF REPTILES for Dark Horse. He also drew three CADILLACS AND DINOSAURS covers for Topps Comics. In addition to his comic book work, Delgado is a concept artist on such projects as STAR TREK: DEEP SPACE NINE, the FORBIDDEN PLANET remake and the forthcoming Arnold Schwarzenegger film TRUE LIES. In the photo at left, he is holding a spaceship model he designed for a DEEP SPACE NINE episode called "Vortex."
